authorization.application_use: Authorized under the team Creative Tim Club membership and Access Pass.
authorization.source_publication: The licensed source files are not stored in this repository.
authorization.future_extraction: Requires a separate license and asset distribution review.

adaptation_state.authored: Created specifically for this application; reserved for future manifest extensions.
adaptation_state.adapted: Used as licensed implementation reference or intentionally adapted into first-party code.
adaptation_state.generated: Compiled, minified, or source-map output; retained as reference metadata only.
adaptation_state.runtime-only: Bundled runtime evaluated for replacement or a typed Vue adapter; not copied automatically.
adaptation_state.excluded: Not planned for application or starter-kit distribution.

provenance.creative-tim-licensed: Creative Tim premium source covered by the project authorization.
provenance.third-party-bundled: Third-party source bundled inside the licensed package.
provenance.generated-bundle: Compiled or minified output distributed in the licensed package.
provenance.bundled-media-unverified: Bundled media whose original author and redistribution terms require review.
provenance.source-package-metadata: Build or release metadata from the licensed package.
provenance.external-service: Remote dependency referenced by an example page.

distribution.application-only: Authorized for adaptation inside this application; not approved for starter-kit extraction.
distribution.application-only-review-before-extractio: May be used in this application but requires asset-level review before extraction.
distribution.reference-only: May inform the implementation but is not copied into application output.
distribution.runtime-evaluation-only: Evaluate and replace or isolate before any runtime use.
distribution.generated-reference-only: Generated vendor output is recorded but not distributed from this repository.
distribution.replace-or-self-host-before-extraction: Choose an approved replacement or separately licensed self-hosted asset.
distribution.review-required: No distribution decision has been made; resolve before use.
